matching.normalization: casefold; Unicode alphanumeric tokens; punctuation, hyphen, and underscore become token boundaries
matching.evidence: evidence unit must point to the same source observation and its exact span must round-trip within that observation

denominators.information_retention_recall: all gold old-state and new-state facts in the selected case history
denominators.fact_semantic_precision_recall: all non-rejected structured MemoryFact claims versus gold facts, paired by source observation
denominators.evidence_precision_recall: structured claims with exact evidence-unit grounding; true positives additionally require exact gold fact identity
denominators.old_state_candidate_recall: gold root-revision pairs for which a new-state candidate was proposed
denominators.direct_revision_prf: gold root-revision pairs with explicit update/invalidation/temporary-exception relation versus traced production revision edges
denominators.seed_prf: gold direct invalidation target states versus production direct seed states
denominators.dependency_prf: gold typed dependency endpoint pairs versus persisted production dependency relations
denominators.propagation_prf: gold propagated invalidation target states versus production propagation-step targets
denominators.false_destructive_rate: false CURRENT-to-STALE/HISTORICAL transitions divided by all destructive transitions

method_failures: A terminal METHOD_FAILURE contributes missing method output to recall denominators; infrastructure-incomplete cases are not scored.
answer_metrics: Normalized exact match and token F1 use the frozen official StateChangeBench normalization and are development diagnostics only.
gold_access: Only after every DEV5 prediction is sealed and seal/source/config hashes verify.
